## 3 matched 8B pairs 汇总

| Seed | CLS acc | CWM acc | Gap |
|------|---------|---------|-----|
| 42 | 89.52 | 86.72 | +2.81pp |
| 123 | 88.89 | 86.47 | +2.42pp |
| 456 | 88.31 | 86.24 | +2.07pp |
